profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at PLACE, Inc
profile.summary: Continuing to push my limits and feeding my hunger for personal improvement are what get me up in the morning :)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently leading a small team of engineers to complete multiple projects within deadlines and scope. Our team’s primary focus is internal tools, legacy code, bugs, and varied data requests from our Support Team and Leadership. Recently we implemented automation that saved the company over $10k monthly. We’ve optimized countless Active Record and PostgreSQL queries to improve application performance and user experience. Coordinating with our Support Team to debug and squash bugs. Mentor and train junior engineers to improve their skills and help guide their professional growth.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Migrated several apps through major Ruby on Rails version upgrades. Designed and implemented strategies for breaking a legacy monolith Rails app into microservices. Collaborated with 3rd party security audits to meet industry standards. Led Dev Retros, conducted code reviews and provided feedback to improve code quality. Contributed to the development of best practices and internal documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: We build software for the real estate world and beyond! Currently there are 2 Ruby on Rails projects, Brivity and ActiveRain, that I dedicate time to. I do everything from developing new features, to gathering user feedback, to interviewing new developer candidates. We're a small team here in Bellingham, so we do what it takes to accomplish the task! We're currently hiring for many positions, message me to find out more :)
positions.insights: Skills: AJAX · PostgreSQL · Ruby on Rails · Shell Scripting · JavaScript · Ruby

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: My fellow co-founder and I took an idea that fills a financial niche, and built a full production web application to create a marketplace for exchanging product invoices. I primarily worked on server side code, app architecture, test automation and API integrations. We focused on mobile first design patterns, security for financial information, and user testing.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Very small team. Building web, iOS, and Android applications to disrupt the trucking industry. Currently working on implementing a mobile web application. The rest is top secret :)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Contract work for Rock Health. Built a custom Ruby on Rails application from the ground up. I work the whole stack! There are public and administrative features. Setup, and maintained database. Integrated front-end designs from designer. BDD Testing via Cucumber. Balancing deliverables and current work with Product Manager.

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description: Maintained Ruby on Rails application, implemented new features, updated old ones. Worked together with small startup team to drive company goals forward. Increased user base through online and in person interactions.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I've built websites using the Wordpress framework. Working with clients and designers to achieve the client's web presence goals.

positions.title: Admissions Counselor
positions.description:
This position requires keeping in constant contact with students, counselors, and other school administrators. Prioritizing leads and arranging effective travel for out of state efforts are also valuable to success in this role.

From student inquiry to matriculation I work with prospective students to help them complete their applications. Once that application is complete, I review it and make an admissions decision. In the event of a denial, I provide points that can be improved on and recommend that they re-apply during the next round.

I'm responsible for recruiting from all of the states west of the Mississippi. Traveling to national level college fairs and conventions spreading the APU message and recruitment plan. In Anchorage I visit local high schools and work with high school counselors to find the top prospects from each graduating class.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant for Liberal Studies, Early Honors, and the Master of Arts Programs
positions.description: I provide program support to faculty members for 3 programs here at APU. This support ranges from technology acquisition and set up to creation of documents and mass communication efforts. I also assist students within the programs with any hurdles they may encounter. Whether this be directing them to other resources in the APU family or general help with adjusting to college life. For many, I am a warm smile and happy to discuss all things APU!

positions.title: Admissions Advisor
positions.description: I recruit potential students and help them reach their career goals through education. From initial contact to a student's first day of class, I am their primary resource for information on ACC's programs and services.

positions.title: Advertising Account Executive
positions.description: I help businesses use the Anchorage Press and Arctic Warrior to meet their advertising needs both in print and on the web.

projects.title: ONDAGO DJ Entertainment
projects.description: Worked directly with business owner and a graphic designer to achieve design goals. Setup connections to existing online accounts and streamlined the quote generation process for users.
